name: badge
description: Classes that style a <div> or <span> as a small colored label. CSS only.

props.variant: Add badge--primary, badge--warning, badge--danger, badge--info, or badge--notice by hand. With none, the badge is neutral.
props.notification: Add badge--notification-left or badge--notification-right by hand. The parent needs btn--with-badge, which only sets position: relative. In a right-to-left page, the badge moves into the parent, not out of it: inset-inline-start and inset-inline-end flip, but translateX() does not.

props.name: Material Symbols only: badge.css sizes .material-symbols-outlined, so an icon from another pack keeps its own size.

modifiers.badge--notification-left: Absolute, on the top left corner of the parent, with a ring
modifiers.badge--notification-right: Absolute, on the top right corner of the parent, with a ring

customPropertiesNote: No custom properties. Every value comes straight from a global token. Each variant sets background-color and color directly, and both notification modifiers repeat the same ring and position rules.
